```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('Projecte absent')
    root=root.parent
d=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/autocorrelacio-exemples.json').read_text())
rows=[s for s in d['sections'] if s['association_sample']]
assert len(rows)==126
x=np.array([s['mean_area'] for s in rows]);chosen=next(i for i,s in enumerate(rows) if s['key']=='4314806006')
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':18,'svg.fonttype':'none','svg.hashsalt':'autocorrelacio-denominadors'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,5.3),layout='constrained')
for ax,field,title,label in [(axes[0],'log_count','Divisió pel nombre d’edificis','ln(1 + kW per 100 edificis)'),
                             (axes[1],'log_area','Divisió per superfície de petjada','ln(1 + kW per 1.000 m²)')]:
    y=np.array([s[field] for s in rows]);r=np.corrcoef(x,y)[0,1]
    ax.scatter(x,y,s=32,color='#3c869f',alpha=.75)
    b,a=np.polyfit(x,y,1);xx=np.array([0,3300]);ax.plot(xx,a+b*xx,color='#b52e45',lw=2)
    ax.scatter(x[chosen],y[chosen],s=100,color='#b52e45',edgecolor='white',zorder=4)
    ax.annotate('D',(x[chosen],y[chosen]),xytext=(-18,10),textcoords='offset points',weight='bold',color='#b52e45')
    ax.set(title=title,xlabel='Petjada mitjana per edifici (m²)',ylabel=label,xlim=(0,3350))
    ax.text(.04,.94,f'r = {r:.3f}'.replace('.',','),transform=ax.transAxes,va='top',bbox={'facecolor':'white','edgecolor':'none','alpha':.85})
    ax.grid(alpha=.13)
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/autocorrelacio-denominadors.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
